text:
You’re looking for guidance on how to apply AI best practices in an AWS-based e-learning system, especially with experience in educational use cases.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. In a recent project, Clinical note summarisation for Brightwell Clinics, I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model on AWS that drafts visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs are masked; it reached ROUGE-L 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

I can help you evaluate where AI fits best in your e-learning workflow, what to automate first, and how to keep the system practical and scalable on AWS.

What part of the e-learning flow do you want AI to improve first: content generation, learner support, or assessment?
